test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.**

The new intern is a __greenhorn__ and thus his superiors take advantage of him.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Inexperienced'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The correct meaning of the word '**greenhorn'** is a person who is inexperienced or new to a particular field. (एक व्यक्ति जो अनुभवहीन है या किसी विशेष क्षेत्र में नया है)

 
 
• *Example: As a **greenhorn **in the tech industry, he was eager to learn from his more experienced colleagues.*
 
 
 
• The meaning of the word 'Inexperienced' is having very little knowledge or experience about something.
 
• Hence, the correct meaning of the idiom 'greenhorn' is 'Inexperienced'.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the other word's meaning:

 
 
• Jealous: extremely resentful of someone or their achievements. (ईर्ष्यापूर्ण)
 
• Overenthusiastic: unduly enthusiastic. (बहुत ज़्यादा उत्सुक)
 
• **Sick**: having some kind of physical or mental illness. (बीमार)
